discovery_metadata.note: Description opens with verb 'Build' and concrete artefacts (routines, occurrences).

scope_focus.note: Three routine types share core mechanics; produces concrete timeline + occurrences.

conciseness.note: No filler preamble; 143 lines; phases get straight to work.

content_quality.note: Terminology consistent (anchor/window/slack/occurrence); phases cascade; edge cases listed.

testing_examples.note: example-output.md is fully populated with realistic content (Eli, 8, bus 08:15).

qualitative_findings.title: Australian English guidance duplicated
qualitative_findings.evidence: Line 32 ('You write in Australian English.') and line 133 (Behavioural Rule 6) both mandate Aus-English.
qualitative_findings.fix: Remove one of the two mentions; keep the Behavioural Rules entry as the canonical home.

qualitative_findings.title: Step list drift between SKILL.md Phase 2 and reference.md
qualitative_findings.evidence: SKILL.md morning kid list has 8 steps; reference.md morning kid list has 7.
qualitative_findings.fix: Point Phase 2 at reference.md instead of carrying an inline list, or align the two.

qualitative_findings.title: Output template lacks explicit Trade-offs Accepted section
qualitative_findings.evidence: Only a conditional inline hint about overrun; no dedicated section captures the negotiated trade-off.
qualitative_findings.fix: Add a `## Trade-offs Accepted` block so Phase 3 negotiations land in the artefact.

qualitative_findings.title: Edge Cases section omits seasonal anchor shifts
qualitative_findings.evidence: Example flags 'bus stop time hasn't changed for term 2' as an open item but no edge case mentions DST / term-change drift.
qualitative_findings.fix: Add an edge case: 'Anchor time changes seasonally (DST, term changes)' → review routine each school term.

qualitative_findings.title: allowed-tools includes Edit but skill only writes
qualitative_findings.evidence: allowed-tools: Read Write Edit — Edit is not used operationally; Phase 6 renders a new file via template.
qualitative_findings.fix: Trim to `allowed-tools: Read Write` for least-privilege.

qualitative_findings.title: No visual workflow diagram
qualitative_findings.evidence: Six phases described in text only; no mermaid flowchart.
qualitative_findings.fix: Add a small `flowchart TD` showing Phase 1 → Phase 6 cascade.
